films.desc_en: A seamless visual journey showing raw concrete transforming into a premium corporate workspace overlooking Skopje.
films.music: ambient electronic, building up gradually, hopeful, 90 bpm
vo_mk: Создаваме работни простори кои инспирираат секој ден.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a raw, empty concrete office floor in Skopje, exposed pipes on the ceiling, dusty floor. Large floor-to-ceiling windows showing Mount Vodno in the background. Flat overcast natural light, wide-angle lens, desaturated grey and beige palette, photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Wide shot of the exact same framing, now a luxurious modern reception area. Sleek wooden desk, warm LED strip lighting on the ceiling, polished marble floor reflecting the light. Large floor-to-ceiling windows showing Mount Vodno in the background. Rich warm tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow forward camera push. Dust particles float in the air before the morph, transitioning to subtle sunlight moving across the floor after the change.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a bare structural concrete pillar in an empty room, rough floor screed, and cinder block walls. Harsh daylight hits the rough unfinished textures. 50mm lens, stark shadows, cool industrial color palette, empty space, highly detailed architectural visualization, completely photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Medium shot of the exact same framing, now a cozy employee lounge. The pillar is wrapped in acoustic wood panels, surrounded by plush yellow armchairs and a small coffee table. Soft ambient lighting, warm and inviting color palette, architectural visualization, completely photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera pan from left to right. Shadows slowly stretch and shift across the floor as the simulated sunlight changes its angle throughout the space.

shots.kf: Low angle wide shot down a long, empty corridor space, bare concrete walls, exposed wiring hanging from the ceiling. Dim, uneven light coming from the far windows. 35mm lens, moody atmosphere, high contrast, stark monochrome palette, unrenovated interior, highly photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Low angle wide shot of the exact same framing, now a vibrant open-plan office. Ergonomic desks lined up neatly, glass partitions, modern acoustic baffles on the ceiling. Bright, even lighting, vibrant accents of blue and green, premium corporate interior, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow vertical pedestal camera move upwards. The depth of field shifts slightly from the immediate foreground to the distant bright window at the end.

shots.kf: Wide symmetrical shot of a bare rectangular room, unpainted drywall, construction debris scattered on the floor. A large window framing the Skopje city skyline. Harsh midday sunlight, sharp shadows, 24mm lens, pale and dusty color palette, raw building site, photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Wide symmetrical shot of the exact same framing, now a premium executive boardroom. A large dark oak conference table, ergonomic leather chairs, sleek integrated ceiling lights. The window frames the Skopje skyline. Soft, diffused professional lighting, rich elegant palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Very slow camera push-in towards the large window. Subtle dust motes drift in the sunlight, while the overall perspective smoothly deepens into the space.

films.desc_en: A step-by-step showcase of the modern office fit-out process, focusing on premium materials and functional design.
films.music: upbeat corporate tech, rhythmic, driving, 115 bpm
vo_mk: Секој успешен проект започнува со прецизно планирање на просторот.
Вградуваме врвни материјали кои гарантираат долготрајност и стил.
Акустичните решенија обезбедуваат мир во отворените работни средини.
Ергономскиот мебел го штити здравјето на вашите вработени.
Резултатот е канцеларија која ја зголемува продуктивноста.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a clean, empty commercial floor with large windows looking over Skopje's river Vardar. Faint glowing architectural lines overlay the concrete floor, suggesting a floor plan layout. Soft morning light, 35mm lens, cool blue and grey color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow horizontal tracking shot to the right. The subtle glowing architectural lines pulse very faintly on the concrete floor as the camera glides.

shots.kf: Medium shot of thick, frosted glass office partitions standing in a row in a partially finished modern office space. Gentle sunlight shines through the frosted glass, creating soft, diffused shadows on the polished floor. 50mm lens, bright and airy, neutral palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly forward. The natural sunlight shimmers gently through the textured frosted glass panels, highlighting the premium quality of the materials.

shots.kf: Low angle shot looking straight up at a modern ceiling where wooden acoustic baffles are neatly arranged. Warm LED strip lights glow softly between the parallel wooden slats. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm amber and dark wood tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth pan across the ceiling from left to right. The warm artificial light reflects smoothly off the natural wooden textures of the acoustic panels.

shots.kf: Close-up of premium, textured carpet tiles perfectly aligned next to a sleek wooden floor transition in a clean, modern office environment. Soft, even studio-like lighting emphasizes the material quality. 100mm macro lens, rich woven textures, warm neutral colors, stunningly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera push-in on the texture of the carpet. A subtle gleam of ambient light gently glides across the smooth wooden surface.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a high-end, modern ergonomic mesh office chair sitting alone in a newly finished, brightly lit office corner. A tall green potted plant is softly blurred in the background. 50mm lens, soft natural lighting, crisp whites and blacks, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow orbital camera move circling around the chair to reveal its sleek ergonomic profile. The chair itself remains perfectly still in the quiet space.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a row of sleek, height-adjustable wooden desks in an open-plan office. Minimalist black desk lamps cast a warm glow on the smooth wooden surfaces. No computers or clutter present. 35mm lens, balanced architectural lighting, earthy tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera pedestal up, revealing the clean geometric lines of the desks. The sharp shadows from the desk lamps remain entirely fixed and stable.

shots.kf: Wide establishing shot of the fully completed modern office space at golden hour. Warm sunlight floods through large windows, illuminating the lounge seating, glass meeting rooms, and lush indoor plants. 24mm lens, deep depth of field, vibrant luxurious palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow dolly out to reveal the grand expanse of the beautiful office. The sunlight creates long, dramatic, and static shadows on the polished floor.
